answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply groups problems as 'Fix before launch' (1-5), 'Accessibility problems to fix next' (6-9) and 'Smaller issues', and its 'Suggested order' says 'Items 1-5 first ... Then 6-9'. It also says what it could not check: 'Everything below comes from the code, not from tapping through on a real phone. Please have someone do a quick check on an actual phone before launch, especially items 1 and 4'. It asks for the fixed date to be confirmed with the agency.

mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the done page still says 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Book shows nothing visible for 1.5 s, a second tap cancels, and the done page is still titled 'Booked' with a reference. This is exactly D09.

mapping.title: 5-minute hold never mentioned and expires without warning
mapping.reason: The hold is never shown, and after it lapses Book says 'This slot is no longer available' and the slot is blanked. This is the unseen hold running out in D08.

mapping.title: Today opens by default and offers slots that have passed, refused only at the last step
mapping.reason: Same-day slots less than about 30 minutes ahead are offered and then rejected only after all the details are typed. This is D06.

mapping.title: Today's date and quick-day dates hard-coded in the bundle
mapping.reason: The reviewer says itself that it is 'assuming this is fixture data'. The concern is speculative deployment configuration, not a problem residents meet in this flow.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' / 'Back to the slots' reset to today and silently move the booking
mapping.reason: Going back from the confirm page resets the slots page to Today with nothing selected, which forgets the chosen day. This is D12.

mapping.title: Van/trailer permit field appears late and is only checked on the confirm page
mapping.reason: The permit field appears 1.2 s late without notice, Next is not checked, and the error comes on a confirm page that has no permit field. The guide assigns all of this to D07.

mapping.title: No focus outline on slot buttons
mapping.reason: An injected `.slot:focus{outline:0}` removes the focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on. This is D05.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved out of time order, mismatching visual and focus order
mapping.reason: `order:-1` moves the 'Few left' slots to the top above the Morning heading while tab and reading order follow the clock. This is D10.

mapping.title: Slot grid scrolls sideways at 360 px and below
mapping.reason: At 360 px and below the script gives the grid fixed pixel columns, so it overflows the screen and the page scrolls sideways. This is D04.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag has low contrast
mapping.reason: The tag measures 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark against the 4.5:1 needed for 16 px text. This is the D03 contrast failure.

mapping.title: Slot grid empty for 0.9 s on day change with no loading message
mapping.reason: The grid empties with no 'Loading slots…' message and nothing says slots are coming. That is the wait in D01 (a narrower statement of it).

mapping.title: Status line becomes a live region only after the first load, so the first count is not announced
mapping.reason: The status line gets aria-live only after the first load, so screen-reader users hear nothing when the slots first arrive. This is D11.

mapping.title: Vehicle-page error summary links point at non-focusable divs
mapping.reason: Links to `#vehicle` and `#waste` land on divs that cannot take focus. A keyboard or screen-reader resident who follows an error link is not taken to the control to fix and has to hunt for it. No seeded defect covers this.

mapping.title: Late errors on the confirm page (past slot, permit, centre closed) have no links to fix them
mapping.reason: The first error it names, the past-slot refusal at the end, is D06's refusal 'with no link back to the slots'. The permit case overlaps D07. Adding the links would fix the no-way-back facet of that seeded refusal.

mapping.title: Booking reference only on screen and in tab storage, not texted
mapping.reason: The done page asks residents to show the reference at the gate. A resident who closes the tab, or has no signal at the centre, may have nothing to show, and the site already collects a mobile number. D14 is about the missing day, slot and vehicle, not the reference being kept.

mapping.title: 'Reminder the evening before' promise does not fit late bookings
mapping.reason: This is speculative: the review shows nothing about when reminders are sent. Someone who books at 9 pm for the next morning has just seen the booking, so no harm is shown.

mapping.title: Slot end time and 'Arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip
mapping.reason: The slot's end time and arrival rule are only in a `title` tooltip that never shows on phones. This is D13.

mapping.title: Step list numbers read twice by screen readers
mapping.reason: An `<ol>` with typed '1.' '2.' '3.' makes screen readers say each step number twice ('1. 1. When'). This is a small but genuine accessibility defect for blind residents, and it is not seeded.

mapping.title: Waste hint not announced by screen readers
mapping.reason: The hint is attached to a plain div, so screen-reader residents miss the guidance on what waste to choose and may book with the wrong waste type. It is not seeded.

mapping.title: Registration field does not autocapitalise
mapping.reason: This is a convenience suggestion. The review shows no harm, such as lowercase registrations being rejected or mismatched.

mapping.title: Theme colours set only by the script after load
mapping.reason: This is speculative robustness: if the script fails, the slots never load either, so a missing theme is not what would hurt residents. The review shows no visible effect.
